title: SolarSelect Commercial Solar Panel Catalogue Schema
description: Canonical schema for commercial photovoltaic modules used in SolarSelect Layer B recommendation and configuration engine.

panel_id.description: Unique immutable identifier for each catalogue entry (e.g., PNL-001, PNL-TRINA-330).

manufacturer.description: Official legal or commercial name of the PV module manufacturer (e.g., Trina Solar, SunPower).

model.description: Manufacturer model identifier or series designation as stated on technical datasheet.

rated_power_wp.description: Nominal peak power rating under STC (Wp). Must be strictly positive.

module_efficiency_pct.description: Module gross aperture conversion efficiency under STC (%).

stc_irradiance_w_m2.description: Standard Test Condition reference irradiance (nominally 1000 W/m²).

stc_cell_temperature_c.description: Standard Test Condition reference cell temperature (nominally 25°C).

length_mm.description: Physical module outer length along frame (mm).

width_mm.description: Physical module outer width along frame (mm).

area_m2.description: Gross module surface area calculated as (length_mm * width_mm) / 1,000,000.

weight_kg.description: Gross module weight including frame and junction box (kg).

pmax_temp_coefficient_pct_per_c.description: Temperature coefficient of maximum power (gamma_Pmp). Physically negative for silicon cells.

voc_temp_coefficient_pct_per_c.description: Temperature coefficient of open-circuit voltage (beta_Voc). Physically negative.

isc_temp_coefficient_pct_per_c.description: Temperature coefficient of short-circuit current (alpha_Isc). Physically positive.

noct_c.description: Nominal Operating Cell Temperature (800 W/m², 20°C ambient, 1 m/s wind) (°C).

nmot_c.description: Nominal Module Operating Temperature under modern IEC 61215 standard (°C).

vmp_v.description: Voltage at maximum power point under STC (V). Must be < voc_v.

imp_a.description: Current at maximum power point under STC (A). Must be < isc_a.

max_system_voltage_v.description: Maximum allowable DC string system voltage (typically 1000V or 1500V IEC/UL).

max_series_fuse_rating_a.description: Maximum allowable series protective fuse rating (A).

product_warranty_years.description: Manufacturer warranty duration against materials and workmanship defects.

performance_warranty_years.description: Manufacturer guaranteed linear power output warranty duration.

annual_degradation_pct.description: Guaranteed maximum linear annual power degradation rate (%/year).

end_of_warranty_power_pct.description: Guaranteed residual power output percentage at end of performance warranty period (%).

price_per_module.description: Observed or quoted commercial unit purchase price for single module.

price_per_wp.description: Normalized commercial price per rated peak watt (price_per_module / rated_power_wp).

currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g., USD, AUD, EUR, INR).

price_basis.description: Commercial supply chain pricing context and tier.

price_region.description: Geographical region or national market where pricing was quoted (e.g., Australia, US, India, Global).

price_confidence.description: Confidence level in commercial pricing accuracy.

price_observed_date.description: Date on which the price quote or index was recorded (YYYY-MM-DD).

specification_source.description: Primary repository file, datasheet, or catalogue from which record was extracted.

specification_source_url.description: Documented URL for manufacturer product page or datasheet if available in repo.

source_document_name.description: Formal filename or document title of manufacturer technical specification datasheet.

source_page.description: Page number or section in source document where ratings appear.

verification_status.description: Traceability and verification level of the record specifications.

verification_date.description: Date on which specifications were verified against authoritative source (YYYY-MM-DD).

notes.description: Technical notes, special mounting requirements, certification standards, or provenance disclaimers.
